title: Sheet pan salmon and vegetables
summary: Everything on one tray, twenty minutes in the oven, one thing to wash. The trick is giving the vegetables a head start.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C / 425F. A hot oven is what roasts vegetables instead of steaming them.
Toss the broccoli, pepper and onion with 1 tbsp oil, half the salt, the oregano and pepper. Spread them out on the tray in a single layer with gaps - a crowded tray steams.
Meanwhile rub the salmon with the remaining oil, garlic, paprika, the rest of the salt and the lemon juice.
Pull the tray out, push the vegetables to the edges, and lay the salmon skin-side down in the middle with the lemon slices on top.
Back in for 10-13 minutes. It is done when the thickest part flakes under gentle pressure from a fork and is still faintly translucent in the very centre.
Rest 2 minutes. Scrape the garlicky pan juices back over everything.
tips: Overcooked salmon is the one real failure mode here. White curd appearing on the surface means it has gone too far - pull it earlier next time.
In an air fryer: vegetables at 190C for 8 minutes, then salmon on top for 8-10 more.
Works exactly the same with any thick white fish - check it 3 minutes earlier.
health_notes: Salmon is the easiest way to get real omega-3s into a weeknight. Two servings a week of oily fish is the standard recommendation and this is one of them handled.

source.adapted: Standard sheet-pan method, staggered so the fish is not overcooked by the time the vegetables are done.
